name: minitok
tagline: Verified repository-aware coding workflows for MCP clients
description: minitok exposes repository-aware coding workflow controls to MCP clients. It separates research, planning, implementation, deterministic verification, review, repair, and evidence recording. Local stdio execution is read-only by default; repository-changing scopes require explicit configuration and approval. An active minitok entitlement and configured provider credentials are required for production workflow methods.

env.name: MINITOK_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE
env.description: Owner-only runtime token file created by minitok mcp connect.

env.name: MINITOK_MCP_SCOPES
env.description: Explicit scopes; defaults to read. Add write and verify_exec only when intended.

env.name: MINITOK_SERVER_URL
env.description: Optional HTTPS minitok service URL override; defaults to https://api.minitok.dev.

install.notes: Install @flotic/minitok@1.4.5, run minitok doctor, authenticate the user, and run minitok mcp connect cline --scopes read. Repository-changing scopes require explicit write and verify_exec configuration.
